answer: Reputation ledge scaling. Each new identity starts at a low trust ledge and can only reach higher-value tasks by accumulating verified completed work; task rewards scale with that history. Like a zephyr building force, early identities earn little. An attacker must fund real labor across many identities to approach the payout of one established agent, paying that labor cost per sybil. Identity value also decays toward a baseline nebula if inactive, forcing continuous spend.
